search.dedup: rg --no-ignore --hidden --follow across records, research, reviews, history and .claude; all 160 baseline record paths/IDs/names/kinds/SHA inventoried. Relevant prior raw directories round24-frontier, round24-nimh and round24-sulfuric plus current raw inspected. Initial optional .agents/.codex paths returned nonexistent errors; no dependent completeness claim relies on them. Unrelated home/temp trees were not searched.
search.result: LED and sulfur were known research leads, not existing resource records. Existing fluorescent phosphor, LCD panel, elemental sulfur or battery black mass records do not identify these feeds. No matching blister/can/pickling resource or DOI found in the specified pre-dossier search (exit 1); late beverage-carton lead remains unassessed.

limits: Prepared mixed lamp feed without component/model inventory
Species authority NCBI 930 verified; PTCC 1717 stock not independently resolved
Centrifugation does not demonstrate sterile supernatant
Unequal starting pH and trajectories confound chemical comparison
Chemical acid gives greater reported Nd extraction
Equation 1 denominator and mass/pulp-density terminology unresolved
Table 5/Table 6/conclusion numerics and element labels conflict
Sulfate background and fitted production estimates are not measured sulfur-conversion yield
No specific EPS/enzyme/precipitate mechanism established; no isolated product or scale-up experiment

sources.title: Indirect bioleaching for metal recovery from battery black mass using microbially generated acid from a secondary sulfur resource
sources.state: Full 10-page PDF; complete Methods/Results/Discussion/Conclusion, all Figures 1-4/Table 1 checked. Local rendered pages 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 viewed. Publisher HTML/link list checked for associated artifacts.
sources.license: CC BY printed on page 1; raw retained outside Git.
sources.supplement: No study-specific supplementary link in inspected HTML anchors or full PDF; no raw data deposit acquired.
limits: Biogas desulfurization powder has no reported complete composition or supplier-specific characterization
Paper calls DSM 1927 A. thiooxidans; live DSMZ resolves A. ferrooxidans F221, experimental stock unresolved
DSM 9466 resolves A. caldus C-SH12 but does not establish individual causal contribution
Source-labelled basalt salt medium not silently repaired or reconstructed
Repeated-cycle retained liquor/solids prevent single-cycle yield inference
Acid-production independent replication and uninoculated residue control not supplied
Reported 0.63 M acid/pH 0.44 are solution observations, not conversion/purity/isolated-product yield
Downstream NMC black-mass assays are different-material context; no sulfur-source advantage from them
No process TEA/LCA or industrial deployment

authority_checks.result: Live species label Acidithiobacillus thiooxidans verified; no experimental stock authentication.
Live catalogue Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans F221 conflicts with source A. thiooxidans; no inferred repair.
Live catalogue Acidithiobacillus caldus C-SH12 consistent with second culture label; causality remains mixed.
A. caldus species verified for context only; no organism CURIE added to mixed mechanism.
